components.name: Numeric Field
components.css: .ds-numeric-field{display:grid;gap:7px;padding:9px 12px 6px;border-block:1px solid #BFC1C8;border-radius:0;color:#606777;text-align:left;font:650 14px/1.35 system-ui,"Noto Sans TC","Microsoft JhengHei",sans-serif}.ds-numeric-field input{box-sizing:border-box;width:100%;min-height:46px;padding:7px 0;border:0;border-radius:0;background:transparent;color:#202838;text-align:left;font:600 18px/1.35 system-ui,"Noto Sans TC","Microsoft JhengHei",sans-serif}.ds-numeric-field input:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #C88725;outline-offset:2px}

components.name: KPI Cell
components.css: .ds-kpi-cell{display:flex;min-height:64px;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:12px;padding:7px 16px;border:0;border-radius:0;background:transparent;color:#202838;text-align:center}.ds-kpi-cell strong{color:#283B86;font:650 32px/1 system-ui,"Noto Sans TC","Microsoft JhengHei",sans-serif}.ds-kpi-cell span{max-width:12ch;font:400 15px/1.35 system-ui,"Noto Sans TC","Microsoft JhengHei",sans-serif}.ds-kpi-cell:focus-within{outline:3px solid #C88725;outline-offset:2px}

components.name: Evidence Row
components.css: .ds-evidence-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(90px,1fr) minmax(110px,1fr) auto;gap:16px;align-items:center;padding:7px 0;border-bottom:1px solid #BFC1C8;border-radius:0;background:#FFFDF8;color:#202838;font:400 15px/1.5 system-ui,"Noto Sans TC","Microsoft JhengHei",sans-serif}.ds-evidence-row:hover{background:#F0F1F6}.ds-evidence-row:focus-within{outline:3px solid #C88725;outline-offset:2px}

narrative.overview: Credit XAI Audit presents verified Machine Learning and Trustworthy AI evidence as a compact editorial research console. A warm reading field, deep-indigo structure, restrained amber state accents, large Traditional Chinese thesis copy, and dense evidence rows make the interface feel like a serious technical publication rather than a generic risk dashboard. The product remains an educational replay of a historical 2005 dataset, never a lending system or financial decision tool.
narrative.keyCharacteristics: Depth is flat. Create hierarchy with typography, aligned columns, one-pixel transition rules, and one cool result field. Lines mark transitions; they do not enclose every item. Do not use shadows, floating panels, blur, glass effects, decorative gradients, or repeated container chrome.
narrative.rules: The desktop container is at most 1440px wide. The first viewport follows a 12-column editorial composition: thesis and content-sized scope boundary, four equal unboxed KPI pairs, then a 7/5 input-to-result workspace. The input plane uses one alignment system: heading and metadata share the first row, case status and controls share a second baseline, a compact left-aligned group index owns the third row, and the active fields form one shared-rule editorial ledger below it. Equal field cells use consistent left insets and internal hairline separators; the primary action matches one active ledger track on wider screens. Calibrated probability and model metadata share one content-driven facts row on non-phone layouts, stack in source order below 520px, and do not reserve filler height. Successful attributions occupy a conditional full-width evidence band below the workspace; empty and error states reserve no table space. At 820px the workspace stacks in source order and feature inputs use three equal ledger columns; below 520px the group index and fields use two equal columns without page-level horizontal scrolling. The primary action is compact on wider screens and full-width only on narrow phones. Center only short, equal-weight content such as status labels, KPI pairs, compact controls, and the primary action. Keep thesis copy, explanatory prose, navigation labels, form labels and values, model metadata, attributions, and evidence rows left-aligned.
narrative.dos: Do keep Traditional Chinese primary, use original technical terms, preserve visible focus, maintain stable loading and error geometry, and trace every public claim to committed evidence. Do use rules to mark section transitions rather than to build containers. Do center only short, equal-weight content. Do preserve the historical educational-audit, privacy, CPU-only, and non-decision boundaries.
narrative.donts: Don't use rounded dashboard cards, pills, repeated rectangles, full-width desktop actions, fabricated numbers, decision language, shadows, decorative animation, or network-loaded visual assets. Don't imply causal proof, current-market fairness, lending eligibility, approval, rejection, or financial advice. Don't let runtime requests, responses, bundles, or caches write into the public repository.
